svg.text: What a bigger bell buys: vacuum Isp vs expansion ratio
ideal frozen-flow nozzle · γ = 1.2 · T₀ = 3600 K · M = 22 g/mol (illustrative LOX/hydrocarbon-class gas, not a specific engine)
expansion ratio ε = Aₑ / A* (log scale)
Going from ε = 30 to ε = 100 adds only about 17 s. Diminishing returns are why bell length and mass become the real trade.
